summaries.Romania: Romania faces political gridlock as parties negotiate government formation, while security concerns mount with Russian drone incursions near the border. Economic indicators remain mixed, with inflation pressures and workforce participation challenges dominating policy discussions.
summaries.Healthcare: Healthcare innovation accelerates with digital platform modernization and AI integration into clinical workflows, while pricing pressures intensify through MFN drug agreements and prior authorization reforms. Patient data security emerges as critical concern amid multiple cybersecurity incidents.
summaries.Tech: Apple completes its CEO transition as John Ternus takes over from Tim Cook, signaling continuity in hardware innovation ahead of major product launches. AI model development races forward with cost reductions and capability expansions, while geopolitical tensions reshape tech ecosystems through platform policy changes.

items.title: Here’s how much Apple is paying John Ternus as CEO, Tim Cook as executive chairman
items.snippet:
In a new regulatory filing today, Apple revealed that new CEO John Ternus is receiving a pay package with $58 million in salary and target stock awards. The company also shared details on Tim Cook’s lucrative new deal as Apple’s executive chairman.

items.title: White House unveils next round of MFN pricing deals with 9 midsized drugmakers
items.snippet: Some four months after the White House inked the last of its expected drug pricing deals with 17 of the industry’s top players, the U.S. government is back for round 2, this time lining up agreements with a host of medium-sized biopharmas under President Trump’s ‘most favored nation’ agenda.

items.title: McKesson confirms cybersecurity incident as hackers claim millions of patient records stolen
